metadata.description: Interface design skills in two packages: the Glass package, an exact system to copy, and interface-design, the same practices fitted to your own project.

plugins.name: interface-design
plugins.description: Seven skills that apply one set of interface best practices — type hierarchy, colour and theming, layout, surfaces and depth, motion, product patterns and UI copy — in your project's own names and values, via a DESIGN.md the setup skill writes for you.

plugins.name: glass-package
plugins.description: The exact design system running on modimihir.com — typography, colour, layout, glass and motion — with its real values and drop-in assets, to copy as-is.
